semantics: All unquoted keywords must match one admitted public resource across the selected fields; order and adjacency are irrelevant. Match existence, rather than relative ranking or engine tokenization, is the assertion.

ASCII double quotes group a contiguous ordered phrase inside one field. Multiple unquoted terms and quoted spans are conjunctive. Backslash escapes a literal quote or backslash. An unmatched quote is 400 invalid_query; no regex, wildcard, boolean or field-operator language is introduced.

Preserve the caller's q verbatim in selection, including quote syntax and Unicode. Canonically equivalent composed/decomposed text finds the same records. CJK and one-character text remain searchable. No transliteration, accent stripping or compatibility folding is required.

title, body and credit retain their existing meanings; label is the admitted public name of any resource and summary is its admitted description. Unquoted terms may span selected fields; a quoted phrase never spans fields. language selects matching text language, independently of UI locale or display preferences.

Scope is all/global or realm with the same Context realm. Reuse filter-document-v1 type, Concept and language constraints with their existing interpretation and revision semantics. No server default clears filters when q changes.

Eligibility, names, descriptions, types and discussion labels come from shared admitted capabilities and live disclosure. A new type/provider must not require a search branch. rdf:type, membership, ownership, moderation and platform roles supply no public search authority.

Each item is one logical resource identity, without duplicate aliases or support rows. Same-named Character records retain their distinct identities and useful admitted summaries. Known identity/name/types survive absent optional description with summary null and summaryStatus missing. unavailable means a known description dependency failed; it cannot fabricate a summary or change identity.

complete describes traversal, not descriptive metadata completeness. A final page has nextCursor null, complete true and exact count. A continuing page has complete false and an honest exact or at-least count over admitted results. There is no fixed result-window product cap.

Opaque cursors bind q including quotes, selected fields, language, filter/semantic revisions, sort, Context, scope, page limit and public presentation/read basis. Reusing one after changing a selector refuses explicitly. Private changes alone must not reveal a hidden identity or create a new invalidation signal.

recovery none returns suggestions status not-requested with no items and never corrects q. recovery suggest returns at most three explicit spelling requests; original results still answer the original q. A suggestion's request preserves every effective selector, substitutes q, drops cursor and uses recovery none.

Every suggestion is supported by a record and matching text that the caller may publicly search under the exact fields/language/filter/scope. Applying it is a separate client request. No hidden label, prefix, fragment, source ID, count or private metadata may appear in results, counts, summaries or recovery.

Suggestion-only unavailability is suggestions status unavailable with no items while independent exact results survive. Search/read-basis unavailability remains 503; it is never a successful empty catalogue. This spec does not select a ranking, correction algorithm or index.

fixturePlan.budget: 600000 ms per complete preparation/restore including startup, migrations, readiness, API smoke and the stopped backup; exceedance is a setup blocker.
